item.description: Donald Trump said the US is unlikely to accept Iran's new peace proposal. Iran submitted a 14-point plan to Pakistan. The dour outlook came after Iran’s Tasnim and Fars news agencies said Tehran had submitted a 14-point proposal to mediator Pakistan.

item.title: Trump insists China trip will go on as planned; analysts say leaders' summit crucial to manage risks
item.description: US President Donald Trump said his China trip will proceed as planned. Chinese observers stress the leaders' summit is crucial for managing risks amid global uncertainty. United States President Donald Trump says his upcoming visit will be an “amazing event”, while Chinese observers say both sides need to prioritise risk management in the face of rising uncertainty worldwide.

item.description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un addressed the ruling party's youth league congress in Pyongyang, mobilising citizens aged 14 to 30 to support state goals. The once-in-five-years gathering is aimed at boosting national unity and loyalty.
